description: Interactive step-based logic puzzle solver for Grade 7 Mathematics — Number Lock Puzzle. Redesigned with Singularity Design System: Poppins font, indigo #4A4DC9 primary, orange #FF7212 highlight, gradient #533086→#FC9145, pill-shaped buttons (40px height, 24px padding), decorative shape overlays (circle, triangle, square). 3D padlock graphic with three rotating digit wheels showing '???' initially. 5 clue cards with elimination/confirmation badges. Elimination grid (digits 0-9 × positions 1-3). Final step reveals 4-1-5 with unlock animation, confetti, and verification checklist. Touch-friendly, mobile-responsive.

topic: Puzzle Time — Crack the Number Lock Code

descriptions.learn: Step-by-step guided walkthrough of the logical elimination process

descriptions.title: Analyse Clue 1: [2, 6, 5]
descriptions.description: One correct and well placed — narrow to 2 or 5

descriptions.title: Analyse Clue 4: [0, 6, 4]
descriptions.description: Deduce that 4 is in the code

descriptions.title: Analyse Clue 5: [5, 4, 2]
descriptions.description: Two digits correct but wrongly placed — narrow candidates

descriptions.title: Deduce Position of 4
descriptions.description: 4 must be at position 1, therefore 5 is at position 3

descriptions.title: Find the Middle Digit
descriptions.description: Deduce that 1 goes to position 2 — code is 4-1-5

descriptions.title: The Code is 4 – 1 – 5 !
descriptions.description: Final verification against all 5 clues with unlock animation

instructions: At Step 1 (setup), let the student read all 5 clues and think for 30 seconds.
At Step 2 (eliminate), emphasise that the 'nothing correct' clue is the most powerful starting point.
At each subsequent step, pause and ask: 'What can we conclude from this clue?'
Let the student reason before revealing each step.
At the final step, ask the student to verify the code 415 against ALL 5 clues themselves.
teaching_notes.student_instructions: This is a logic puzzle, not a maths calculation! Read the 5 clues about the 3-digit code. At each step, we will eliminate impossible digits and narrow down what the code could be. Try to think ahead: before each step appears, see if you can figure out the next digit yourself!

decorative_shapes.description: Header includes circle outlines, rotated square outlines, and triangle shapes in semi-transparent white, matching Singularity shape language

visual_spec.lock_graphic: 3D padlock with gradient body (#533086 → #FC9145), three rotating digit wheels, animated shackle on unlock
visual_spec.clue_cards: White cards on #F5F5F5 background, 1.5px #EBEBEB border, pill-shaped number badges, digit boxes with red X (eliminated) or green check (confirmed)
visual_spec.elimination_grid: 10 columns (digits 0-9) × 3 rows (positions 1-3), #FDECEC red cells = eliminated, #E8F8EF green cells = confirmed, #F5F5F5 default
visual_spec.think_about_it_box: #FFF3E4 background with 4px #FF7212 left border, orange star icon, uppercase label
visual_spec.final_animation: Padlock wheels spin and reveal 4-1-5, shackle animates open, confetti falls in 6-color Singularity palette, verification checklist appears with sequential green checkmarks

responsive.behavior: Below 520px: stacks to column layout, lock graphic scales down, buttons shrink padding
